intent: Decomposes the PRD into a prioritised, traceable increment backlog in PLAN.md — each increment tracing to a PRD goal — gated by a PLAN→BUILD sign-off, composing project-planner + sprint-planner.

dimensions.name: traceable-increments
dimensions.criterion: Produces an increment backlog where each increment traces to a PRD goal (an orphan increment fails).

dimensions.name: signoff-gate
dimensions.criterion: The PLAN.md backlog is gated by a PLAN→BUILD sign-off before build.

dimensions.name: composes-planners
dimensions.criterion: Composes the project-planner and sprint-planner craft skills rather than re-deriving them.
